plugins.name: agentille
plugins.description: Personal AI coding orchestrator for Claude Code (trigger: /agt). See your agents work: a live band above the prompt and a pixel team deck show every agent's role, model, effort, state and tokens. A routing mod enforces model + effort per role and escalates to Fable only on observed failure. Project-aware squads (saas, ecommerce, content, immersive) add payments, SEO and performance specialists. Subagent-first dispatch, panes (Herdr or tmux) or workflows for parallel work, agent teams only when forced.
